purpose: Infrastructure placement and default-deny runtime policy for screenshot-led external-tool research batches 5 and 6.

hosted_request_process.rule: No screenshot-led third-party desktop app, CLI, agent framework, media renderer, proxy client, OSINT tool, or recovery toolkit executes in the Vercel request process.

browser_progressive_enhancement.rule: Only sanitized, bounded, feature-detected rendering may reach the browser; secrets and cross-tenant data are prohibited.

desktop_companion.rule: Requires explicit local user control, signed builds, permission indicators, update policy, rollback, and no silent telemetry or capture.

isolated_worker.rule: Media/browser/subprocess workloads require bounded CPU, memory, disk, network, input validation, tenant isolation, and job-level audit logs.

developer_workstation_or_ci.rule: Developer/recovery tooling stays outside customer runtime; dry-run or operator confirmation is required before workstation mutation.

research_only.rule: Architecture, UX, vendor, or orchestration reference only until a separate approved implementation changes status.

presentation_preference.rule: May influence response formatting only after review; cannot diagnose, infer, or store a medical condition.

growth_control_plane.rule: Read-only audits first. Platform writes require explicit account authorization, before/after diff, blast-radius review, owner approval, idempotency, audit logging, rollback, and verification.
